wave_preset_draft_name.label: New preset name
wave_preset_draft_name.description: Give the preset a short name, pick up to three dropdowns below and click Save. Saving the same name again overwrites.

wave_preset_draft_mood.label: New preset: mood
wave_preset_draft_mood.description: Energy and mood of the tracks.

save_wave_preset.label: Save preset
save_wave_preset.description: Adds the values above to Saved presets. The list is shown under Radio then My Presets in Browse.

delete_wave_preset.label: Delete selected preset
delete_wave_preset.description: Removes the selected preset from the Saved presets list.

auth_device.label: Login with device code
auth_device.description: Open a verification URL on any device and enter the short code.

auth_qr.label: Login with QR code
auth_qr.description: Opens a QR code page — scan it with the Yandex app on your phone.

remember_session.label: Remember session (auto-refresh token)
remember_session.description: When enabled, stores a long-lived session token to automatically refresh your music token when it expires. When disabled, you must re-authenticate manually when the token expires.

token.label: Yandex Music Token (manual)
token.description: Advanced: manually enter a music token. See the documentation for how to obtain it.

my_wave_max_tracks.label: My Wave maximum tracks
my_wave_max_tracks.description: Maximum number of tracks to fetch for My Wave playlist. Lower values load faster but provide fewer tracks. Default: 150.

liked_tracks_max_tracks.label: Liked Tracks maximum tracks
liked_tracks_max_tracks.description: Maximum number of tracks to show in Liked Tracks virtual playlist. Higher values may significantly increase load time and risk triggering Yandex smart-captcha. Lower values load faster. Default: 200.

restrictive_rate_limits.label: Restrictive rate limits (datacenter / VPN safe mode)
restrictive_rate_limits.description: Enable when Music Assistant runs on a VPS, NAS-behind-VPN, or any datacenter IP. Caps total in-flight requests to Yandex below the edge concurrency limit observed for those IPs (~6 simultaneous), trading some browse / recommendations responsiveness for fewer captcha trips. Residential users do not need this — Yandex tolerates much higher concurrency from regular ISPs.

manifest.description: Stream music, personalized recommendations, and lossless FLAC from Yandex Music — including My Wave radio and library sync.
